name: the five Mushoku Tensei runs stay five

source.test: the five Mushoku Tensei runs stay five

why: These are five distinct broadcast runs: 2021-01, 2021-10, 2023-07, 2024-04 and 2026-07. Two of them are both "season 2" (kitsu:45950 and kitsu:47694), so an ordinal cannot separate them and only the 273 days can. Welding any pair puts one run's episodes under another's page, which is exactly what the owner reported on 2026-08-31.
